first_step_test: One bold double-lobed shell contour with a pinched waist makes the peanut readable immediately and gives the learner one connected shape to copy.

source.notes: Generate one six-panel cumulative felt-tip marker contact sheet; preserve failed iterations privately under the slug draft folder.

final_elements.name: double-lobed peanut silhouette
final_elements.description: One diagonal peanut shell with two rounded lobes, a pinched waist, and softly pointed ends.

final_elements.name: central shell seam and two inner rims
final_elements.description: One curving center seam plus one inner rim curve inside each of the two lobes.

final_elements.name: first diagonal groove family
final_elements.description: A spaced family of short diagonal shell grooves running down-right across both lobes.

final_elements.name: crossing groove family and shell bumps
final_elements.description: A second groove family crossing the first plus three small raised shell bumps.

final_elements.description: Exactly two open-paper highlight shapes and one broken deep-navy shadow beneath the peanut.

frames.visible_job: Draws one bold diagonal double-lobed peanut silhouette with a narrow waist.
frames.instruction: Draw one long peanut shell tilted from upper left to lower right. Round both lobes, pinch the middle inward on both sides, and finish each end with a soft uneven point.

frames.visible_job: Adds one curving center seam and two inner rim curves inside the fixed outline.
frames.instruction: Pull one wavy seam through the middle from the upper tip to the lower tip. Add one shorter inner rim curve inside each lobe, following the outer shell without touching it.
adds: central shell seam and two inner rims
introduces: central shell seam and two inner rims

frames.visible_job: Adds one evenly spaced family of short diagonal shell grooves across both lobes.
frames.instruction: Across both lobes, draw short diagonal grooves that lean down toward the right. Stop every groove at the outer contour, center seam, or inner rim so the shell stays clean and readable.

frames.visible_job: Adds the crossing groove family and exactly three small raised bumps to the unchanged shell.
frames.instruction: Add a second family of short grooves leaning the opposite way to make a loose diamond texture. Place exactly three small rounded bumps along the shell, keeping them inside the established outline.
adds: crossing groove family and shell bumps
introduces: crossing groove family and shell bumps

frames.visible_job: Adds exactly two open-paper highlights and one broken shadow beneath the established shell.
frames.instruction: Reserve exactly two small highlight shapes, one on each lobe, then draw one broken shadow beneath the lower edge without touching the peanut outline.

final_step.visible_job: Fills the established shell warm tan and ochre and deepens the existing shadow without adding structure.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established shell with warm tan and ochre marker, pulling strokes along each lobe. Deepen the existing seam and grooves with brown, color the same broken shadow deep navy, preserve both paper highlights, and add no new contours.
adds: warm marker color on established shell forms

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one thick, slightly uneven diagonal outline with two rounded lobes, two inward waist pinches, and softly pointed ends. It is recognizable as a whole peanut shell, easy to copy as one connected shape, and contains no premature seams, texture, bumps, highlights, shadow, or color.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Compared all six saved crops pairwise. The double-lobed outline, wavy center seam, two inner rims, both groove families, three raised bumps, two reserved highlights, and three-part broken shadow keep their locations; the final adds warm tan, ochre, brown, and navy only within the established design.
